description: Moves a task to a board stage (column). Tasks must only advance; backward move is allowed only to 'Task' or 'Blocked Task' (e.g. impediment or not finished). Use board_stage_name or board_stage_id. For stages that require 'Link da branch', fill it first with runrunit_update_task.

board_stage_name.description: Stage name (e.g. 'Task', 'Ongoing', 'Manager Validation', 'Ready for production'). Partial match, case-insensitive.

name: runrunit_move_task_stage
